To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a typology of consumers who use curated retailing in the fashion industry based on their shopping motivations.

we identified four segments of curated retail shoppers: store oriented online shoppers who are willing to change their online shopping behavior to benefit from the advantages of curated retail, fashion conscious changeres who are willing to adopt curated retail because of the advantages for their fashion shopping, choice support seekers who are willing to use curated retail because of a need for support and independent apathetic shoppers who are neither willing to change their shopping behavior nor to benefit from curated retail.

the shopping motivations of consumers for adopting curated retail fashion shopping can be clustered into four segments: store oriented online shoppers, fashion conscious changels, choice support seekers, and independent apathetic consumers.
